note: BTK inhibitors cleared rodent collagen-induced arthritis uniformly, but in MTX/TNF-inadequate-responder RA only fenebrutinib met a Phase 2 endpoint; poseltinib, elsubrutinib, BMS-986142 and evobrutinib failed.
label: Rheumatoid arthritis (BTK)

engagement.model: BTK occupancy probe in CIA mice
engagement.note: Fluorescent affinity probe measured BTK active-site occupancy in CIA mice; occupancy tracked BCR blockade and efficacy. No human comparison yet.
engagement.short: Probe measures BTK occupancy in CIA mice
engagement.quote: Occupancy of the Btk active site by PCI-32765 was monitored in vitro and in vivo using a fluorescent affinity probe for Btk.

engagement.model: BTK occupancy probe in CIA mice
engagement.note: CC-292 occupancy that tracked CIA efficacy in mice was reproduced in healthy volunteers: 2 mg/kg engaged all circulating BTK; RA patients later showed 83-88%.
engagement.short: Full BTK occupancy in humans as mice
engagement.quote: This first-in-human healthy volunteer trial has demonstrated that a single oral dose of 2 mg/kg CC-292 consistently engaged all circulating Btk protein and provides the basis for rational dose selection in future clinical trials.
engagement.reason: Occupancy in humans matched the mouse
engagement.judgement: Abstract-level (JPET paywalled). Comparison is in healthy volunteers, not patients. Patient-level occupancy agrees - median 83-88% in RA patients (Schafer 2020, 10.1007/s40744-019-00182-7) and 'adequate target engagement' for elsubrutinib (Fleischmann 2022) - but is not a status change, so no extra entry.

dose.note: Model set the exposure rule: BTK occupancy tightly correlated with efficacy in CIA mice, so blood occupancy became the dose target for the class.
dose.short: Occupancy tracks efficacy in CIA mice
dose.quote: Active site occupancy of Btk was tightly correlated with the blockade of BCR signaling and in vivo efficacy.

dose.note: Fenebrutinib doses were set to the exposure that cleared rat CIA; 150 mg QD and 200 mg BID beat placebo on ACR50.
dose.short: Rat-CIA exposure target worked in patients
dose.quote: as this extent of inhibition was correlated with efficacy in a rat collagen-induced arthritis model
dose.judgement: Full text read (PMC7496340). The Methods sentence ties the plasma-concentration target to rat CIA; the PMC rendering drops the subscript after 'IC' so the exact target (probably IC90) is not quoted. The trial then met ACR50 at the two model-derived doses but not at 50 mg QD. Model side: Crawford 2018 rat CIA (10.1021/acs.jmedchem.7b01712); healthy-volunteer PK/PD: Herman 2018 (10.1002/cpt.1056).

dose.note: Elsubrutinib reached adequate exposure and target engagement at all doses yet matched placebo; the rat-CIA occupancy target did not translate. BMS-986142 repeated this.
dose.quote: No significant improvements in efficacy measures for elsubrutinib alone (any dose) versus placebo were detected, despite adequate plasma exposure and target engagement.
dose.reason: Target engaged, exposure adequate, no response
dose.judgement: Abstract-level (Lancet Rheumatol paywalled, 403 on fetch). Model side is Goess 2019 (10.1080/14397595.2018.1484269): ABBV-105 BTK occupancy in rat CIA correlated with efficacy. Conaghan 2023 (10.1016/S2665-9913(23)00089-9) says the same for BMS-986142 and names extent of BTK inhibition and drug distribution to inflamed sites as the open questions. Called contra on the dose question because the exposure/occupancy the model deemed sufficient was achieved in patients and did not work; a scorer may prefer to fold this into efficacy and leave dose at same.

efficacy.note: Ibrutinib completely suppressed mouse CIA; the model was then used for every BTK inhibitor taken into RA (CC-292, GDC-0853, ABBV-105, BMS-986142, evobrutinib, poseltinib).
efficacy.quote: In mice with collagen-induced arthritis, orally administered PCI-32765 reduced the level of circulating autoantibodies and completely suppressed disease.

efficacy.note: Fenebrutinib 200 mg BID: ACR50 35% vs placebo 15% in MTX-inadequate responders, comparable to adalimumab (36%); 25% vs 12% in TNF-IR (NS).
efficacy.quote: Fenebrutinib demonstrated efficacy comparable to adalimumab in patients with an inadequate response to methotrexate, and safety consistent with existing immunomodulatory therapies for RA.
efficacy.judgement: Primary endpoint met at two of three doses (ANDES, NCT02833350). The paper cites rat CIA only as the basis for dose selection, so the efficacy comparison is my juxtaposition with Crawford 2018. Spebrutinib's 4-week n=47 study (Schafer 2020: ACR20 41.7% vs 21.7%, p=0.25) trended positive but was unpowered, so it is not counted either way. Genentech nonetheless dropped RA; approval status was not used for the call.

efficacy.note: Poseltinib, which cleared mouse CIA, was stopped at interim for futility; elsubrutinib (2022) and BMS-986142 (2023) then also failed despite CIA efficacy.
efficacy.quote: While no safety findings precluded continuation, the study was terminated after interim data demonstrated low likelihood of benefit in RA.
efficacy.judgement: Abstract-level (J Rheumatol paywalled); year is print year (epub 2020-12-15). Model side: Park 2016 mouse CIA (10.1186/s13075-016-0988-z). Later failures: Fleischmann 2022 (elsubrutinib; Goess 2019 rat CIA), Conaghan 2023 (BMS-986142; Gillooly 2017 mouse CIA/CAIA, 10.1371/journal.pone.0181782). Evobrutinib's Phase 2b failure (NCT03233230, results posted 2020-09-28; model Haselmayer 2019, 10.4049/jimmunol.1800583, 80% occupancy gave near-complete CIA inhibition) was never published as a trial paper. Registry postings put the failures before the fenebrutinib success: BMS-986142 2019-05-28, poseltinib 2019-10-09 - under a registry-date rule contra would precede same.

safety.note: A mouse 28-day finding (spermatid degeneration) excluded men from the spebrutinib trial; no published comparison of any BTK-inhibitor tox prediction with RA patients.
safety.short: Mouse tox shaped trial, never compared
safety.quote: men were excluded from participating based on a preclinical toxicology finding of maturing spermatid degeneration in a 28-day study in mice
safety.judgement: Full text read (PMC7021855). The class's patient-side safety signal is transient ALT/AST elevation (BMS-986142 350 mg arm stopped at interim, Conaghan 2023; evobrutinib pooled EAIR 4.8 vs 2.8, Montalban 2022, 10.1136/jnnp-2022-328799), but no primary source states whether toxicology species predicted it, so safety stays untested. Toxicology certainly predates 2020 (first-in-human 2013) but no earlier primary source naming it was found.
